_about: Tolerance sets quoted from the commissioning guidance. The harness reports pass/fail against them as research targets; radiarch is not commissioned for clinical use.

mppg5.source: AAPM MPPG 5.a (Smilowitz et al., JACMP 2015) and 5.b (Geurts et al., JACMP 2022); implementation in Jacqmin et al., JACMP 2017 (PMC5689890)
mppg5.low_dose_region_note: 3 %/3 mm when evaluating low-dose and high-gradient regions

tg218.source: AAPM TG-218 (Miften et al., Med Phys 2018): IMRT QA gamma criteria

tg119.source: AAPM TG-119 (Ezzell et al., Med Phys 2009) and the instructions (Zenodo 8037934)
tg119.published_note: multi-institution results in the TG-119 report, 3 %/3 mm

tecdoc1583.source: IAEA TECDOC-1583 (2008), criteria after Venselaar et al. 2001; CIRS 002LFC thorax phantom, eight test cases
tecdoc1583.note: delta values are of the local dose except delta4 (percent of the central-axis dose)

proton.source: AAPM TG-185 (IMPT commissioning) and TG-224; MCsquare validation literature (Huang et al. 2018; TOPAS within 1.8 % on dose indices)
